title: EPC Contractor Tripartite Liability & Worker Protection Matrix

covenants.requirement: Contractor pays 100% agreed wage to worker; platform commission strictly 0.00%
covenants.enforceability: Criminal and civil breach if violated

covenants.requirement: Wages held in direct tripartite escrow prior to worker dispatch; immune from contractor lien or bankruptcy
covenants.enforceability: Autonomous bank release on job completion

covenants.requirement: Contractor cannot suppress worker roster or rate defensively during open disputes; binding ombudsperson adjudication
Mandatory accidental insurance (minimum ₹5,00,000 coverage) and PPE provision prior to heavy site entry
covenants.enforceability: Site entry prohibited without verified coverage
